text.text: The NEC PC-6001 was released in 1981 as a compact home computer designed for education, programming, and entertainment. It was part of NEC's PC-6000 series and featured built-in BASIC, color graphics, and sound capabilities. The system supported cartridges and cassette storage, with software including educational programs and games. The PC-6001 was popular in Japan and helped expand home computer ownership during the early 1980s.
